title: Why The Rich Stay Rich (And You Don't)

scenes.vo: Two people earn the exact same salary. Ten years later, one is rich and one is broke. Here is the real reason.
scenes.caption:
SAME SALARY.
DIFFERENT LIFE.

scenes.vo: When most people get money, they spend it on things that take money out of their pocket. A newer phone. A nicer car. Meet Cardy. Every swipe makes him stronger, and you weaker.
scenes.caption:
THE POOR BUY
LIABILITIES

scenes.vo: The rich do the opposite. They buy assets. Things that put money back in. Stocks, a business, index funds. Piggy takes that money and grows it while they sleep.
scenes.caption:
THE RICH BUY
ASSETS

scenes.vo: That is the whole secret. The poor work for money. The rich make money work for them. One dollar becomes two. Two becomes four. And it never stops.
scenes.caption:
MONEY WORKS
FOR THEM

scenes.vo: You do not need a bigger paycheck. You need your first asset. Start with one. Follow for more money moves.
scenes.caption:
START WITH
ONE ASSET
